landing.heroSub: Tell other restaurant operators about Purple POS. They get 20% off their first month. You earn 15% commission every time they pay — for as long as they stay subscribed.
landing.how.title: How it works
landing.how.sub: From sign-up to your first commission in four steps. No subscription required.
landing.how.step1.title: Sign up
landing.how.step1.body: Create a free Referral Partner account in under a minute. No POS subscription needed.
landing.how.step2.title: Share your code
landing.how.step2.body: You'll get a personal code (e.g. PURPLE-ABCD) and a shareable signup link.
landing.how.step3.title: They subscribe
landing.how.step3.body: Friends sign up at 20% off. Your dashboard tracks every click and conversion in real time.
landing.how.step4.title: Get paid
landing.how.step4.body: 15% of every paid invoice lands in your wallet. Withdraw to your bank — anytime, in any supported currency.
landing.why.title: Why partners choose Purple
landing.why.recurring.title: Recurring, not one-off
landing.why.recurring.body: 15% commission every month — for as long as your referral keeps paying. The longer they stay, the more you earn.
landing.why.multicurrency.title: Multi-currency wallet
landing.why.multicurrency.body: Refer customers in MYR, USD, KRW, SGD — your wallet keeps each currency separate. Apply credit to invoices or withdraw to your bank.
landing.why.transparent.title: Transparent dashboard
landing.why.transparent.body: See clicks, sign-ups, active referrals, and earnings broken down per partner — never wonder how your network is doing.
landing.why.noSubscription.title: No subscription required
landing.why.noSubscription.body: You don't need to use Purple POS to refer it. Existing customers, consultants, and restaurant friends — anyone can earn.
landing.calc.title: How much could you earn?
landing.calc.sub: Pick a plan and your expected number of referrals — see your monthly recurring revenue.
